record.oneLiner: One of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs, from Patagonia.
record.description: Giganotosaurus was a giant carcharodontosaurid theropod of Late Cretaceous Argentina and one of the largest known land carnivores, roughly 12–13 m long. Its holotype is about 70% complete, making it one of the better-known giant predators of the Southern Hemisphere.

notableFacts.text: Among the largest known land carnivores — rivalling or exceeding T. rex in length.
Its skull alone measured over 1.5 m long.
